}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:10.214
    | text      = This is destruction. This is scorched earth. This is siege

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.015
    | text      = by design.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:16.275
    | text      = So Cloward and Piven were two academics who put forth a theory
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.174
    | text      = in the 1960s. Their basic point was that the way that the current welfare state was designed was inherently
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.914
    | text      = meant to not address the problem of poverty, but to put a Band-Aid on it. There are tons of social
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.934
    | text      = safety net type programs that people are eligible for, but the state actively dissuades them
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:35.595
    | text      = from knowing that they're eligible from the, uh, for them,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:38.275
    | text      = and tries to make them reluctant to sign up for these programs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:41.994
    | text      = They theorize that if massive welfare drives were organized, then people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:45.154
    | text      = who were eligible for public assistance would be more likely to sign
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.275
    | text      = up for the help that they needed. In the process, it would create a burden that the existing welfare
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:52.974
    | text      = system could not handle because the idea that it's actually meant to handle that, uh, uh, is an illusion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:58.994
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:59.134
    | text      = And that's an illusion that we understand and can maintain because the system hasn't been, uh, crushed by-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:05.894
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:06.154
    | text      = ... people getting the aid that they're eligible for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:07.694
    | text      = It works until you go look for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:09.714
    | text      = Yes. By having people sign up for the assistance they were eligible for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.214
    | text      = but the state could not provide, the welfare system would collapse, and from that collapse would come the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:17.674
    | text      = need to redesign what we consider welfare. The hope was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.295
    | text      = that the pressure that this would apply would revolutionize how
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.994
    | text      = we dealt with poverty, and ideally would bring about some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:26.894
    | text      = form of universal guaranteed income. This didn't happen, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.674
    | text      = because it's an attack on the existing welfare state that's rooted in a desire to actually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.194
    | text      = help and provide more assistance to the poor, it's the scariest thing for people on Alex's side of things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.575
    | text      = Attacks on social welfare programs are supposed to be about hurting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.434
    | text      = the poor and consolidating wealth among the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.295
    | text      = powerful, not improving the lives of people in a desperate situation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.894
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.234
    | text      = So when there are people who are attacking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
